# `scm4opt.io`

Input tables (CSV) and report / RCMIP export.

Modules: [`scm4opt.io.datasets`](#scm4optiodatasets), [`scm4opt.io.inputs`](#scm4optioinputs), [`scm4opt.io.rcmip_export`](#scm4optiorcmip_export), [`scm4opt.io.report`](#scm4optioreport)


## `scm4opt.io.datasets`

```text
Scenario input data: checksum manifest, verification, archives for hosting, download.

The scenario inputs (emissions, concentrations, land cover, observations, forcing data)
live in sets, the top-level folders of the data folder (RCMIP3/, AGAGE/, NOAA/,
contrib/). They are described by

  <data>/inputs_manifest.csv   set, path (relative to <data>), bytes, sha256 of every file

and can be distributed as one archive per set:

  pack   <data> -> <out>/scm4opt-inputs-<set>.tar.gz + <out>/archives_manifest.csv
                   (archive, set, bytes, sha256, files)
  fetch  <source>/archives_manifest.csv + archives (a URL or a folder) -> <data>:
         each archive is checked against its sha256 before it is unpacked, and the
         unpacked files against inputs_manifest.csv
  verify <data> against inputs_manifest.csv (missing, changed and unlisted files)

Usage:
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.datasets verify [--data DIR] [--set RCMIP3 ...]
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.datasets manifest [--data DIR] [--set ...]    # (re)write the manifest
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.datasets pack --out DIR [--data DIR] [--set ...]
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.datasets fetch --source URL_OR_DIR [--data DIR] [--set ...]
--data defaults to the model's data folder (config.DAT_DIR: $SCM4OPT_DATA, ...). Exit code 1
if verification fails. fetch takes all sets by default; the sets are not independent:
--scen=rcmip3 runs read RCMIP3/ and the land cover in contrib/LC_*, --load_AGAGE /
--load_NOAA the observation sets.
```

### `sha256(path)`

### `build_manifest(data_dir, sets=('RCMIP3', 'AGAGE', 'NOAA', 'contrib'))`

The manifest of the files of `sets` under data_dir, as a DataFrame.

### `write_manifest(data_dir, sets=('RCMIP3', 'AGAGE', 'NOAA', 'contrib'))`

### `read_manifest(data_dir)`

### `verify(data_dir, sets=None, manifest=None, quick=False)`

Compare data_dir with the manifest. Returns dict(missing, changed, unlisted, checked)
(lists of paths). quick: compare sizes only.

### `pack(data_dir, out_dir, sets=('RCMIP3', 'AGAGE', 'NOAA', 'contrib'))`

One tar.gz per set (paths relative to data_dir) and the archives manifest.

### `fetch(source, data_dir, sets=None, log=<built-in function print>)`

Download (or copy) the archives listed in <source>/archives_manifest.csv, check
their sha256, unpack them into data_dir and verify the files. Returns verify()'s dict.

### `main(argv=None)`

Constants: `ARCHIVES`, `ARCHIVE_NAME`, `MANIFEST`, `SETS`


## `scm4opt.io.inputs`

```text
Scenario inputs for the forward model (the data layer).

Builds, for the configuration in config.RunConfig:
  - the time set t
  - industrial and land-use emissions (dat_eind / dat_elnd / dat_ems)
  - natural forcing (dat_rf_solar / _volcanic / _con)
  - land cover (land_cover_WORLD)

Emissions are kept PER MODEL STEP (1/6 yr), exactly as stored in the input
tables, even though their unit labels say "/yr". Divide by scm_dt only where the
model equations do.

All inputs are CSV files:
  emissions        RCMIP3/<rname>.csv, contrib/<hsrc>_<psrc>/total/<psce>_WORLD.csv
                   (17 significant digits)
  concentrations   RCMIP3/<rname>_conc.csv
  land cover       contrib/LC_<lcov>_<psrc>/<region>/lc_<psce>.csv
  land-use CO2     contrib/<land>_<psrc>/<rgn>/CO2_EMISS_LUC_<psce>.csv
  observations     NOAA/<stem>.gdx.csv, AGAGE/<gas>.csv
  contrib_rfc      contrib/<hsrc>_<psrc>/<fol>/rfc_<X>/<stem>_rfc_<X>_all.csv
                   (one column per ensemble case)
Table files: read_csv_table / read_input; single series: read_input_series.

--scen=rcmip3: emissions from data/RCMIP3/<rname>.csv, time horizon per --rname,
no land-use CO2 override; with --load_conc the prescribed concentrations
(rcmip_conc) of data/RCMIP3/<rname>_conc.csv, optionally overwritten by AGAGE /
NOAA observations.

--fix_conc (contrib): prescribed CO2 concentration from
data/contrib/<hsrc>_<psrc>/conc/<psce>_WORLD.csv.

--scen=contrib_rfc: every forcing component read from
data/contrib/<hsrc>_<psrc>/<fol>/rfc_<X>/..._all.csv for one ensemble --case; no
emissions are needed.

Also: the marginal-analysis period tmargin, the natural forcing adjustments
(--scen=tcre/tcre2, --rdc_rfc, --zero_nature) and the land-cover overrides
(--rdc_lcc).

Not supported (raise or are ignored): psrc=INDC emissions, the ssp1..ssp5
land-cover files, and the contrib options --use_cm, --scmv2, --minus_ems,
--rdc_ems, --fraction and --fix_conc, none of which are set in the contrib
reference run.
```

### class `TimeAxis`

The time set t: integer step n = 0..N-1 <-> label "1850", "1850.167", ...

Use step indices, never float equality on years. `tval` is the value of t,
i.e. the label read as a number (1850.167, not 1850 + 1/6).

Fields: `first_year`, `last_year`, `labels`, `tval`

* `TimeAxis.index(self, label)`: Step index of a time label, e.g. index("2100") -> 1500.

### class `ScenarioInputs`

Fields: `cfg`, `t`, `eind`, `elnd`, `ems`, `ems_1850`, `rf_solar`, `rf_volc`, `rf_con`, `rf_dust`, `tmargin`, `land_cover`, `conc`, `fix_co2`, `rfc_data`, `gas`, `dt`

* `ScenarioInputs.gi(self, gas)`: Column index of a gas in eind/elnd/ems.

### class `PrescribedConc`

Prescribed concentration anomalies (rcmip_conc), on t.

Fields: `D_CO2`, `D_CH4`, `D_N2O`, `D_HALO`, `halo_mask`

### class `RfcData`

Forcing components of one contrib_rfc ensemble case [W/m2] (contrib_rfc_*).

Fields: `comp`, `halo`, `con`

### `to_dense(rec, axes)`

Scatter long records (label columns + "value") onto a dense array.

axes : one sequence of labels per label column, in column order.
Labels missing from the records are left at 0, the value of parameter entries
not given. Records whose labels are not in `axes` are dropped
(e.g. years outside the model horizon).

### `read_csv_table(path)`

Records of an input table CSV, in long form (columns: t, label, value).

Layout: an optional "*" comment row ("*unit,...", "*symbol,..."), a header row
("year" + column labels), then one row per time step with the time
label ("1850", "1850.167", ...; quotes allowed). Values are parsed exactly
(round_trip). Empty cells count as absent (0 after to_dense).

### `read_input(path)`

Records of a time x label input table CSV (read_csv_table); FileNotFoundError
if the file is missing.

### `read_csv_column(path, column, t)`

One column (e.g. an ensemble case) of a table CSV on t, 0 where absent; reads
only that column, so wide tables (1000 cases) stay fast.

### `first_existing(*paths)`

The first of the candidate paths that exists, else the first one (so that the
error names it).

### `read_csv_series(path)`

A 1-D time series CSV as a Series indexed by the time label.

Accepts the headerless two-column layout ('"1958.167",314.8'), with optional "*"
comment lines, and the table layout of read_csv_table with a single value column.

### `read_input_series(path, t)`

A 1-D time input CSV (NOAA / AGAGE observations, land-use CO2) on t, 0 where
absent.

### `load_emissions(cfg, t)`

dat_eind, dat_elnd, dat_ems and dat_ems_1850.

### `tmargin_mask(cfg, t)`

tmargin(t), the marginal-analysis period.

### `load_natural_forcing(cfg, t, tmargin)`

rfc_solar, rfc_volc, rfc_con and rfc_DUST, with the natural forcing
adjustments.

### `load_land_cover(cfg, t, tmargin)`

land_cover_WORLD(t, region_11, land_type) in Mha.

### `load_conc(cfg, t)`

rcmip_conc and chm_HALO_conc, with the AGAGE / NOAA overrides.

### `load_fixconc(cfg, t)`

sce_conc(t, "chm_D_CO2") (delimited table, conc_type columns).

### `load_rfc_data(cfg, t, tmargin)`

Forcing components for --scen=contrib_rfc.

### `load_inputs(cfg=None)`

Load every exogenous input of the forward model for one run configuration.

Constants: `DT`, `GAS`, `GAS_NONF`, `HALO`, `HALO_RCMIP_AGAGE`, `LAND_TYPE`, `REGION_11`, `RFC_COMPONENTS`


## `scm4opt.io.rcmip_export`

```text
Combine the ensemble members of RCMIP3 experiments into RCMIP3 submission files.

An ensemble run (ensemble.py) writes per member, in <csv_dir>/rcmip_<sce><suffix>/:
  SCM4OPTv40_rcmip_phase3_<export_sce>_<case>.csv  RCMIP3 rows of one member (report.py)
  <sce>_<case>_all.csv                             model report, one row per step
This combines one experiment's members into
  <out_dir>/SCM4OPTv40_rcmip_phase3_<export_sce>_ens.csv
with the columns of the RCMIP3 submission template (one row per variable and ensemble
member, members in case order). <export_sce> is <sce>, or <sce>C for the
concentration-driven ScenarioMIP experiments (report.SCENARIOMIP_CONC).

  --src member  (default) stack the per-member RCMIP3 CSVs as written by the runs.
  --src report  rebuild the rows from the per-step report CSVs with output_mapping.csv:
                yearly means over all steps of a year, all-zero series kept (the member
                CSVs follow the reference submission files instead, see report.rcmip_rows).

Members are read in parallel and written one after the other, so memory use stays at a
few members whatever the ensemble size. Values are written at full precision.

Usage:
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.rcmip_export --sce=esm-allGHG-ssp119
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.rcmip_export --csv_dir=/path/to/runs --out_dir=/path/to/ens
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.rcmip_export --sce=ssp585 --sce=ssp126 -j 8
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.rcmip_export --sce=ssp585 --src=report
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.rcmip_export --sce=ssp585 --run_suffix=_hector   # Hector ensemble
  python3 -m scm4opt.io.rcmip_export                 # every RCMIP3 experiment found
Options (also with "-" instead of "_"):
  --sce NAME        experiment (repeat or comma-separate; default: all 135, those found)
  --csv_dir DIR     folder holding rcmip_<sce>/ (default: $mdl_dir, else as ensemble.py)
  --out_dir DIR     output folder (default: <csv_dir>/rcmip3_ens<run_suffix>)
  --out_csv FILE    output file, with a single --sce only
  --run_suffix S    folder suffix of the runs, e.g. _hector (rcmip_<sce>_hector/)
  --src member|report
  --climate_model NAME  climate_model of the rows (default SCM4OPT(PY)v4.0, version.py;
                    "keep" keeps the members' value). Members written before the rename
                    (SCM4OPTv4.0) are relabelled, so they need no re-run for the name.
  -j, --jobs N      parallel readers (default: CPUs - 1, at most 16)
  --outmap_csv F / --template_csv F   mapping / template header (default: package data)
Exit code 1 if no experiment was exported.
```

### `export_name(sce)`

### `member_files(rsl_dir, sce, src)`

[(case, path)] of one experiment's members, sorted by case.

### `rows_from_member(path)`

The member's RCMIP3 rows as written by the run.

### `rows_from_report(path, export_sce, member, mapping, year_cols)`

The member's RCMIP3 rows rebuilt from its per-step report CSV.

### `export_experiment(sce, csv_dir, out_path, src='member', run_suffix='', jobs=1, mapping=None, template=None, log=<built-in function print>, climate_model='SCM4OPT(PY)v4.0')`

Write one experiment's ensemble file. Returns (path, rows, members, first, last),
or None (with the reason in the log) if there is nothing to export.

climate_model : the climate_model written in every row (default: the Python model's
                RCMIP3 name, version.RCMIP_CLIMATE_MODEL); None keeps the members' value.

### `default_csv_dir()`

$mdl_dir, else the folder ensemble.py writes to by default.

### `main(argv=None)`

Constants: `CLIMATE_MODEL`, `DAT_DIR`, `FILE_STEM`, `RCMIP3_ALL_SCENARIOS`, `RCMIP_CLIMATE_MODEL`, `RCMIP_FILE_PREFIX`, `SCENARIOMIP_CONC`


## `scm4opt.io.report`

```text
Model report and RCMIP3 submission rows.

With --rout3=<dir>, a run writes the model report and the RCMIP3 submission rows of
its ensemble member:

  build_report(out, inp, params)  the report symbols, named as the model variables
  write_report_csv(...)           <rout3>/<rname>_<case>_<ctag>.csv: one row per model
                                  step, one column per report symbol (2-D symbols such
                                  as rfc_HFC become rfc_HFC.<gas> columns)
  write_rcmip_csv(...)            the RCMIP3 template rows for this
                                  ensemble member (output_mapping.csv + template xlsx)

REPORT_SYMBOLS lists the report symbols in the reference report order and
REPORT_PARAMETERS the reported parameters, both generated from the variable registry
(varregistry.py); the RCMIP3 export sums the steps of the variables the registry lists
as per_step. NCYCLE_SYMBOLS are reported only with --use_ncycle (the N-cycle module is
not available here, so they are skipped).
```

### `build_report(out, inp, doe_params)`

The report symbols from a coupled run.

out        : scm4opt.run() output; inp : ScenarioInputs; doe_params : DoeclimParams
Returns {symbol: array (n,)} for 1-D symbols and {symbol: (n, k) array} for
rfc_HFC / rfc_PFC / rfc_ODS (columns in their halo-subset order).

### `report_columns(rep, t)`

The report as a DataFrame: index t labels, one column per (flattened) symbol.

### `report_stem(cfg)`

<rname>_<case>_<ctag>, the report file stem.

### `write_report_csv(rep, inp, rout3)`

Write <rout3>/<rname>_<case>_<ctag>.csv (rout3: a folder, with or without a trailing
"/"); returns the path.

### `load_output_mapping(path=None, ref_compat=True)`

output_mapping.csv rows with rpt_out == 1 (the reported outputs).

ref_compat : the export of the reference submission files. False: the variables of
             varregistry.KNOWN_RCMIP_ISSUES (ocean heat content and uptake) get the
             scale implied by their registry and RCMIP units, and are no longer
             summed per year like per-step amounts (PER_STEP_COMPAT): a rate is
             exported as its annual mean.

### `template_columns(path=None)`

Header of the 'your_data' sheet of the RCMIP3 submission template.

Default: its header row saved as a CSV (..._columns.csv), so no Excel reader
(openpyxl) is needed; an .xlsx / .xls path is read with pandas.read_excel.

### `rcmip_rows(rep, inp, mapping=None, template=None, climate_model=None, r_compat=None)`

RCMIP3 submission rows for this run (one ensemble member), as a DataFrame.

climate_model : the rows' climate_model; default --climate_model, else
                version.RCMIP_CLIMATE_MODEL (the original SCM4OPT submits as SCM4OPTv4.0)
r_compat : as the SCM4OPT v4.1 reference submission files (default: --ref_compat):
           yearly means of report parameters skip zero-valued steps, and parameters
           that are zero everywhere get no row; False averages all steps and keeps
           every row.
The mapping defaults to load_output_mapping(ref_compat=--ref_compat).

### `write_rcmip_csv(rep, inp, out_dir, **kw)`

Write SCM4OPTv40_rcmip_phase3_<scenario>_<case>.csv in out_dir; returns the path.

Constants: `CO2_GTC_TO_MT`, `DAT_DIR`, `DT`, `HALO`, `HALO_HFC`, `HALO_ODS`, `HALO_PFC`, `KNOWN_RCMIP_ISSUES`, `NCYCLE_SYMBOLS`, `PER_STEP_COMPAT`, `RCMIP_CLIMATE_MODEL`, `RCMIP_FILE_PREFIX`, `REPORT_PARAMETERS`, `REPORT_SYMBOLS`, `SCENARIOMIP_CONC`
